snippet.description:
Welcome to Redrover's official YouTube channel! Redrover is a pioneering force in K-animation, renowned for producing high-quality CGI content and globally successful animated features. As one of South Korea’s leading creative studios, Redrover blends cutting-edge technology with emotionally resonant storytelling to deliver world-class animation across films, TV series, and immersive platforms including VR and AR.

Best known for the internationally acclaimed Nut Job series, Redrover has played a key role in elevating K-animation on the global stage through strategic co-productions and original IP development. From compelling character design to cinematic storytelling, Redrover is dedicated to crafting animation that connects with audiences across generations and cultures.

With studios in Korea and abroad, Redrover continues to push the boundaries of what’s possible in animation—driving the next wave of K-content innovation for a global audience.
